name: Le dernier Bonbon
source:
Doux's illness has left her physically affected, especially her memory loss. One day, there was a person who claimed to be her angel and gave her a magic candy jar that could help her recall a part of her memories, but she didn't know that her time was approaching the end

[from [url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/le-dernier-bonbon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杜克斯的病给她的身体带来了影响，尤其是她的记忆丧失。有一天，有一个人自称是她的天使，送给她一个神奇的糖果罐，可以帮助她回忆起部分记忆，但她不知道，她的时代已经接近尾声了。

[来自[url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/le-dernier-bonbon]itch.io[/url]]
